objective: Reduce repeated Graph worker context and add a fail-safe Graph-only CI fast path without weakening product verification.

acceptance.description: Compile a compact digest-bound worker context and send it once per live/resumed App Server process; unchanged later turns send only the digest marker while every prompt retains the focused acceptance, with measurable prompt reduction proof.
Select worker knowledge by task relevance before bounded truncation using explicit policy budgets, retaining applicable mandatory safety/execution lessons and excluding unrelated domain knowledge.

Classify pull-request scope fail-safe and run only Graph dependency/typecheck/tests/status/diff checks for true Graph-only changes while workflow or unknown/product/schema changes retain the complete product, DB, and E2E workflow.
Discover changed Graph task JSON files between pull-request base and head and run crm:status for each, reporting no changed tasks cleanly and removing the generic CRM-P0-045 hard-code.
Focused Graph/controller verification passes locally and the exact PR head receives one complete GitHub workflow execution because harness.yml changed.
